items.title: 24.6.2 Electrophoresis se amino acids alag karna (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Electrophoresis mixture ke amino acids ko un ke charge se alag karta hai. Mixture ke chand qatre do electrodes ke darmiyan buffered mehlool mein rakhe filter paper ya gel par dale jate hain. Electric field lagane par amino acids apni pI qeematon ke mutabiq alag hote hain. Agar amino acid ka pI mehlool ke pH se zyada ho to yeh zyada tar musbat shakal mein hota aur cathode ki taraf jata hai; agar pI pH se kam ho to zyada tar manfi aur anode ki taraf jata hai. pI aur pH ka farq jitna zyada, raftaar utni tez. Agar do amino acids ki pI qeematein bohat qareeb hon (jaise glycine aur leucine), to zyada molecular mass wala aahista chalta hai, kyunke charge ko zyada wazan uthana parta hai.

blocks.alt: Manfi electrode (cathode, baen) aur musbat electrode (anode, daen) ke darmiyan peeli patti, beech mein dashed shuruat ki lakeer. pH 6 par lysine (pI 9.74) baen chala gaya, alanine (pI 6.02) shuruat ke qareeb, aur glutamic acid (pI 3.22) daen chala gaya. Neeche: amino acid + 2 ninhydrin se jamni product + CO2 + RCHO + H2O.
blocks.caption: pH 6 par electrophoresis se amino acids alag karna, aur ninhydrin reaction (Figure 24.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: pH 6 par lysine par manfi se zyada musbat charge hai, is liye yeh manfi cathode ki taraf khinchta hai; glutamic acid zyada tar manfi hai aur anode ki taraf jata hai; alanine, jis ka pI taqreeban bilkul 6 hai, par kul charge kam hai aur woh mushkil se hilta hai. Phir be-rang dhabbe ninhydrin se nazar aane wale banaye jate hain.

blocks.text: Amino acids be-rang hain, is liye dhabbe dhoondne parte hain. Ninhydrin pehchan karane wale agent ke taur par use hota hai: yeh amino acids se react kar ke jamni product deta hai. Electrophoresis amino acids ki bari miqdar alag nahi kar sakta; yeh jaanchne ka tareeqa hai ke mixture mein kitne amino acids hain. Poore mixture ko waqai alag karne ke liye column chromatography jaise doosre tareeqe use hote hain.

blocks.prompt: pH 6 par lysine (pI 9.74) kis electrode ki taraf jata hai, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Cathode (manfi electrode) ki taraf: is ka pI pH se zyada hai, is liye is par kul musbat charge hai.

items: pI > pH: musbat, cathode ki taraf; pI < pH: manfi, anode ki taraf.
Ninhydrin be-rang dhabbon ko jamni dikhata.
